target.purpose: Measured silicon optical constants for the educational EUV multilayer/material-data path

candidates.reason: The verified CC0 Si record starts at 30.9963 nm, so using it at 13.5 nm would require unsupported extrapolation.

candidates.source: LBNL/CXRO Henke optical-constants service and Soufli-Gullikson EUV silicon measurements
candidates.reason: Public EUV-range silicon measurements/data access exist, but OpenEUV has not verified redistribution terms that permit checking the numerical table into this repository.

rules: Do not extrapolate a visible/UV silicon dataset down to 13.5 nm and label it measured.
Do not copy a public numerical table into the repository unless redistribution rights are verified.
Keep the simulator layer explicitly illustrative until a measured, redistributable EUV-range Si dataset is pinned.
